name: unit-health.setpoint-read
purpose: Read every unit-health-improve setpoint row from governed validation and calibration reads; declare rows with no governed sensor by their permanent reason instead of estimating them.

target.description: Exact scenario id whose validation feeds the sensor-backed rows. The improve loop regulates unit-health itself; another target reads the same rows for that scenario.

execution.description: Execute the planned test commands during the read. Off by default because an executed run for an arbitrary target can exceed the invoke budget; self-execution is declined with kernel_invoke_budget until the caller accepts it.

reviewed_cohort_id.description: Optional sampled-review cohort attached to the validation sensor read.

reviewed_source_identity.description: Source identity for the optional reviewed cohort.

reviewed_observation_count.description: Observed label count for the optional reviewed cohort.

mutation_package.description: Owner package passed to the optional mutation sensor.

mutation_floor.description: Floor derived from two comparable mutation runs.

roster.description: Bounded explicit scenario roster used when the registry sweep binding is unavailable.

assumptions: Unit Health owns the validation read and its maturity assessment
Rows without a governed sensor are declared, never computed by hand inside the program
invariants: Read only; no test, source, catalog, or corpus edits
Every row is present with keys row, reading, target, in_band, unavailable, reason
A row with a permanent reason never lowers the status; only a failed or unreliable read makes the board partial
A reading is a value the sensor returned or null; unknown is never counted as clean

bindings.note: Transitive binding set of lib.test_genie.validation_digest; the child contract owns the digest composition.

signals.rows: Setpoint rows in improve-skill order: self-maturity, self-execution, unknown-share, rules-promoted, reviewed-evidence, requirement-traceability, calibration-floor, corpus-implemented-share, holdout-agreement, declared-vs-emitted, mutation-signal, fleet-adoption, external-friction
signals.readable: count of rows with a reading
signals.unavailable: count of rows declined with a reason

outputs.evidence: validation run identity, evidence stages, and the binding that answered or failed
